conversion_engine: Microsoft Excel 16.114.2 for macOS, Excel XML file format (51)
macros: VBA execution disabled during conversion; VBA projects removed with user approval; originals retained
calculation: Manual, with calculation before save disabled, to preserve cached source values
validation_scope: Every populated cell value/location, worksheet names/order/visibility, date system, unique merged ranges (duplicate BIFF records normalized), formula counts, and ZIP CRCs in every converted workbook. Numerical comparisons use 1e-13 relative/absolute tolerance (dates: 1e-8 day). Additional text cells are permitted only when a blank original XLS hyperlink is materialized using its stored label, URL (allowing equivalent percent encoding), or internal sheet location; these are counted separately. Native Excel retains formatting; visual layout, formula text, charts, and other embedded objects are not independently compared.
